title: Why Texas Toll Roads Stay Tolled: Where the Money Goes After Construction
direct_answer: Original construction cost, road-level debt, system debt, legal tolling authority, and private concession rights are separate. Texas tolls continue when any controlling system obligation, statute, board decision, reserve requirement, capital program, or contract term remains.
